name: Minotaur Rescue
summary: Minotaur Rescue is an arcade-style game supporting up to four players on iPad (two on iPhone) where players navigate gravity, asteroids, and enemy saucers while rescuing endangered minotaurs to achieve high scores. The game combines classic 8-bit graphics with modern visual effects and touch-optimized controls. Created by Jeff Minter, designer of Tempest 2000 and Llamatron, the game includes two bonus titles: TANKS! and JETS!. Players can compete on OpenFeint and Game Center leaderboards, with the game representing the first entry in the Minotaur Project series that aims to blend retro gaming aesthetics with contemporary gameplay mechanics.
